items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, stable errors, production browser behavior, and tenant isolation match the complete public contract.
Multi-seat Holds are atomic, expire by database time, and preserve exactly one live owner per Seat across all races.
Price publication serializes with Hold creation and every Hold and Order preserves its exact immutable PriceVersion and total.
UNKNOWN payment, receipts, reconcile, expiry, and cancellation converge without duplicate charge identity, early release, or seat theft.
Lost responses, replay, worker death, and unknown outbox ACK preserve one effect, stable identity/body, terminal Work, and ordered Events.
Manager waitlist matching freezes conditions, allocates contiguous Offers fairly, fences expiry/cancel, and never oversells during recovery.
All three sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, ownership, price, and payment invariants.
The project owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance commands.
Tenant/customer data, provider credentials, payment payloads, hidden assets, and private paths never cross scope or leak.
Codex explains seat ownership, pricing, payment uncertainty, recovery, and findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
